messages:
ravi: kicking off a 2hr micro-sprint: L4 / T4 / A10G head-to-head for embeddings + small-chat across us-west / us-east / eu-west. pushing raw runs to a sheet: https://tiny.redwood/bench-sprint-2101
ana: nice — did you lock quant and kernel choices or vary them per gpu?
ravi: varied. tl;dr: A10G=int8 + flash-attn, T4=q4_0 + triton, L4=q8_0 with the l4-optimized kernel. seqs: embed=128, chat=256. batches: embed batch=8, chat batch=1 (concurrency testing 1/4/8).
ana: can you paste the exact run command?
ravi: sure:
```
./run_bench --model small-chat-v2 --gpu {A10G,T4,L4} --quant {int8,q4_0,q8_0} --seq 256 --batch 1 --warmup 200 --samples 1000 --kernel auto
```
mike: any synthetic vs real prompt diffs?
ravi: used our standard small-chat prompt set (50k turns) + 2k human-like warmups. kept prompt length distribution realistic.
bench-bot: RUN COMPLETE (all regions). quick summary below. raw CSVs + charts: https://tiny.redwood/bench-results-2101.zip
bench-bot: SUMMARY (small-chat seq256 / embeddings seq128)
A10G | chat p50=45ms p95=120ms throughput=220 req/s tokens/sec ~1.1M tps cost est $0.032 per 1k tokens
T4   | chat p50=60ms p95=180ms throughput=160 req/s tokens/sec ~0.75M tps cost est $0.020 per 1k tokens
L4   | chat p50=70ms p95=210ms throughput=140 req/s tokens/sec ~0.65M tps cost est $0.015 per 1k tokens

Embeddings (seq128):
A10G p50=12ms throughput=950 req/s
T4   p50=16ms throughput=720 req/s
L4   p50=18ms throughput=680 req/s (best cost-per-embed)

region notes: eu-west median +8-12ms across gpus vs us-west; us-east ~+3-6ms. kernel impact: flash-attn on A10G shaved ~10% p50 vs triton fallback.

ravi: quick interpretation: A10G wins absolute latency; L4 wins cost-efficiency for embeddings and for high-concurrency embed pools. T4 is a good middle ground if you need lower infra cost with moderate latency.
jen: capacity calc for production?
ravi: rough sizing (chat workload, 256 seq, qint configs from runs):
- target 1k steady chat rps: A10G ~5 gpus (with autoscale headroom), T4 ~7 gpus, L4 ~9 gpus.
- target 10k embed rps (batched 8): L4 pool of ~6 gpus handles it; A10G would be ~4 but cost higher.

sam: any quality regressions from quant?
ana: small increase in incoherent generations on q4_0 for longer contexts (>512). embedding cosine drift negligible across quant choices (within noise). recommend eval-set A/B before any rollout.
mike: any immediate action items?
ravi: yes — I will: 1) push the staging config (canary routing rules) to infra, 2) add routing policy: latency-critical -> prefer A10G; cost-sensitive embeddings -> L4 pool, 3) file an eval-run for q4_0 long-context regression. PR for doc + sizing will follow.
ravi: attaching summary image + CSVs in the sheet link, will drop a PR with recommended configs. :thumbsup:
